The technical specification identifies its six-speed sequential transmission, and the checked-out repository already contains the matching curated Aston Martin DBR9 record. The PMR telemetry name is therefore an exact model lead for record reuse, not evidence for a new real-world vehicle.

driver_summary: The Aston Martin DBR9, which Assetto Corsa lists as GT Adonis D9 V12. Six-speed sequential with a lever: the car cuts the upshift, so stay flat. Nothing blips the downshift and whether the gearbox needs one is not established, so blip anyway to settle the car into the corner.
